prompts: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent pixel-art game character sprite sheet, four columns. Reference image is style reference; only Coach Hedge, fourth figure in reference, is also an identity reference. Make a wide landscape sheet of FOUR isolated full-body figures, each centered in its own equally sized quarter of the canvas, generous transparent separation. Left to right: (1) Coach Hedge matching the reference's horned bearded satyr in navy tracksuit, goat hooves, whistle and wooden club; (2) Dylan disguised as a teenage boy, dark Superman-styled hair, confident smile, navy-and-white football jersey with no writing or logos, jeans and cowboy boots; (3) Annabeth Chase, teenage girl with blond ponytail, gray eyes, orange plain T-shirt, jeans, sneakers, bronze shield on her back; (4) Butch, bulky teenage boy with shaved head, orange plain T-shirt, jeans and a small rainbow tattoo on his upper arm. Detailed crisp 2D pixel-art illustration matching reference, natural teenage proportions. All face slightly right in alert standing poses, full heads and complete feet within canvas. No other people, no text, labels, borders, environment or ground. Real transparent alpha background. Exactly one character per quarter, no overlap, no fragments of neighbors.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent cutout for a 2D pixel-art game cinematic. A pair of gray winged horses harnessed to a brightly painted ancient Greek two-wheeled chariot. Three-quarter side view facing left, horses in flight, broad feathered wings raised with powerful readable silhouettes. The chariot is empty, open passenger space clearly visible, bronze fittings and navy/gold painted body. Crisp detailed retro pixel-art illustration with restrained warm highlights and blue-gray shadows, matching a polished 2D fantasy fighting game. The whole chariot, horses, harnesses, tails, hooves and wings inside canvas with generous transparent margins. No people, no landscape, no text, no watermark. Genuine transparent alpha background.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: single transparent sprite sheet for three 2D pixel-art game characters. Reference is Rodrigo's character identity and style reference. Generate three full-length standing figures side by side with large transparent gaps, exactly one Jason, one Piper, one Leo left to right, preserving their recognizable reference outfits, faces, hair and teenage proportions. Jason: blond blue-eyed boy purple T-shirt, jeans and sneakers. Piper: long dark brown hair, purple cardigan, white top, necklace and shoulder bag, jeans and sneakers. Leo: curly dark hair, goggles on head, olive shirt-jacket, white top, jeans, mechanic's tool belt and sneakers. Unarmed, hands empty. Alert natural standing poses turned slightly right, entire heads and feet included. Same detailed crisp pixel-art illustration as reference. No fourth character, no environment, no letters or labels, no ground shadow. Genuine transparent background. Each person occupies a separate nonoverlapping third with generous padding.
